context_for_next_testing_agent: Multiple audios fix verified. The root cause was: stopAllSlideAudios() only sets window.audioTimelineTimers = [] INSIDE an 'if (window.audioTimelineTimers)' check (line 656-659), which fails on first call when array is undefined. Fix: Line 1460 explicitly initializes window.audioTimelineTimers = [] at START of playSlideAudio, BEFORE any code uses it. The guard check in setTimeout callbacks (line 1489) uses '!window.audioTimelineTimers || window.audioTimelineTimers.length === 0' to detect slide changes. Previous fixes intact: hasExplicitTimeline 3-mode detection, slide progress bar, keyboard guard, default text color #000000.
